reason: Losing that $9,000 kitchen job stung, but that quote sat because I didn't get back to him, not because nobody answered the phone. Two grand up front plus 249 a month, before I've seen it catch a single job, is a lot to bet when my notebook and texts mostly work.
objection: 1,999.99 $ for setup is expensive. I'm paying that before I know if my customers will even talk to a robot answering under my company name, and it still doesn't send me the quote. I'd have to write it myself anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Drop the setup fee, or let me pay it only after the first month if it actually brings in a job I would have lost.
